description: Tidegap: at session start, print one line when deferred tasks have finished and nobody has read them yet (silent when nothing is unread or the tidegap CLI is not installed; falls back to the 0.17 ebb command). At session start and end, keep ~/.tidegap/sessions/claude-<pid>.json current, so a task queued from this session knows which session asked for it.

hooks.command: if command -v tidegap >/dev/null 2>&1; then tidegap queue list --unread --hook 2>/dev/null; elif command -v ebb >/dev/null 2>&1; then ebb queue list --unread --hook 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
